[Figure: Diagram of the points to be needled 12]
The Lingshu, Treatise on Reversal Illnesses (厥病論), says: For headache, one may not take the shu (腧) points when there has been a blow or a fall, and evil blood is within, and the injury and pain have not yet ceased; one may needle laterally, but may not take points far away. [Note] The classic says that when evil blood is within, for headache one may not take its shu points. This is because taking shu points for headache drains its qi, and then the headache can be cured. But if there has been a blow or a fall and evil blood is within, and one takes shu points to drain its qi, then this is treating qi for a blood illness; therefore one does not take its shu points.
